caption:
Instagram is officially jumping into longform horizontal video with a new format called Features. Adam Mosseri used to be against it, but now creators can make full widescreen videos and chop them into shorter clips. Are you actually going to watch full shows on Instagram, or is YouTube safe? 📺👇

@netflix_in @youtube @instagram

Source: The Verge

#InstagramUpdate #ContentCreator #SocialMediaNews #CreatorEconomy #InstagramReels

post.news: Instagram is launching Features, a new format for longer widescreen videos, starting small in the US and Brazil.
post.take: First they copied TikTok, now they want to be YouTube. Soon your photo app will just be Netflix.
post.insight: Platforms keep expanding into each other's territories until every app does everything and nothing feels special anymore.
